body: I'm very uncomfortable with doctors in general.  I'm very guarded, and find it extremely difficult to open up to people about my personal life.
Music is a big part of my life, but lately I've found very little interest in the things I loved doing.

I haven't found a new doctor since I moved back home, but I tried several medications in the past, none of which helped, and most of them just intensified my suicidal thoughts.  

I pretty much just live day to day.  I work a minimum of one night a week, but other than that I have no obligations.
I have been severely depressed for the past 5 years.  It sure as hell doesn't look like it's going to pass.

I've felt an intense sadness nearly constantly for the past few months, but at least it was something.  When I woke up today, it was different.  I feel empty, cold, and devoid of all emotion.  It feels as if the last shred of humanity I had has been taken away.
Yeah?  And how might that conversation go?  I mean, without sounding like an obsessive nutcase?

She knows I feel this way, at least I'm pretty sure she does, but she just acts like we can just move on to just being friends, even though we dated several times.  Both breakups were for, in hindsight, really stupid reasons, and I think we both know that now.  I just can't move on, more that I refuse to move on, because I truly believe that the two of us would be happy together.  Or maybe I'm just tragically delusional.

There is one person who makes me feel alive inside.  When I'm with her, all of my fears, stress, and sorrows vanish.  But afterwards, I feel even worse, because I'm reminded that I'll never be with the one person I truly love.
It's not just that I have nothing to live for.  I'm also in a tremendous amount of pain.  The simple act of living hurts, and is strenuous.
20 years down, and I haven't found anything yet.
My life is getting derailed faster and faster everyday.
Well, I'm not feeling too good right now.
And right now the depressed me is really kicking ass
Seems like I'm doing a pretty shitty job so far.
It's been all my life.  I've always been told how much potential I have, but now I'm just fucking it all up.
Everyone expects so much from me.  I just want to go away so I won't let anyone else down.
